meta.rules: Fix the Regev regime and restrict fresh input to poly(n) samples. Amplification creates additional equations at increased noise. Score total asymptotic time under the cited list model. Search-LWE algorithms are admissible as decision upper bounds; a search-only theorem is not silently identified with the source's optimized decision corollary.
